metaTitle: Moon Arc Works – calm, useful mobile apps and games
metaDesc: Moon Arc Works is an independent studio making calm, useful mobile apps and games.
ogDesc: An independent studio making calm, useful mobile apps and games.
lead: Moon Arc Works makes calm, useful mobile apps and games: simple to start, kind to your privacy and fluent in your language.
langNote: Every app speaks 34 languages from day one.
altAaHome: AirAgain home screen: smoke-free days and money saved
altAaHealth: AirAgain health screen: how the body recovers
altAaGoals: AirAgain goals screen: saving for a reward
s1p: A live counter, a 30-day quit program and a 3-minute SOS for cravings, for smoking and vaping alike.
s2p: From 20 minutes to 10 years: see what changes inside you, based on World Health Organization data.
s3h: Turn savings into something you love.
s3p: Pick a reward and see how close every smoke-free day brings you.

altFt01: Fluffytail: the golden valley seen from above the treetops
altFt02: Fluffytail: the squirrel rides a dragonfly through a ring
altFt05: Fluffytail: the Snow Owl flies in behind the squirrel
altFt07: Fluffytail: the squirrel on the Moon, the Earth in the sky
f1h: A storybook adventure to the Moon.
f1p: Redtail the fox has carried little Peanut away. Run, climb, double jump and glide on your fluffy tail through five worlds to bring her home.
f2p: Ride a dragonfly through the rings, race a sled down the snow, row a boat between little islands and take a rocket to the Moon.
f3p: The Snow Owl, a giant hermit crab, Baron Magpie in his junk robot: beaten foes just get dizzy. Nobody gets hurt, and many become friends.
f4h: Made for kids, kind to parents.
f4p: No ads, no tracking, works offline, with three save slots for siblings. The first two chapters are free, and one single purchase unlocks the whole adventure.
appleSoon: Arrives on the App Store on {date}. Coming soon to Google Play.
appleOut: Out now on the App Store. Coming soon to Google Play.
pvTag: Pet health card, nearest vet, lost-pet kit
altPv2: Petiverse: vets and pet shops nearby
altPv3: Petiverse: symptom check and toxic food search
altPv4: Petiverse: lost-pet kit with QR tag
p1p: Log a shot once: the next date and the reminder set themselves, for every cat and dog you have.
p2p: Vets, pet shops, groomers and parks around you. In an emergency, clinics open 24/7 come first, with call and directions in one tap.
p3h: Is it urgent? Is it toxic?
p3p: Tick the symptoms or search a food or plant and see what to do next. It works offline, and it never plays vet.
p4h: Ready if they ever get lost.
p4p: A QR collar tag, a poster and a message to share, ready in one tap. The lost-pet kit is free, always.
pvFree: Free on iPhone and Android. No account: your pet's records stay on your phone.
studioH:
A few quiet rules,
kept in every app.
t1p: No sign-up walls. Your data stays on your phone unless you choose otherwise.
t2p: Every screen, store page and site is written for 34 languages, not translated as an afterthought.
t3p: Clear screens, gentle motion and no noise you didn't ask for.
nextP: A new app is in the works. It will show up here first.
contactP: Questions, ideas or press: we read every message.
